definitions.explanation: The state of losing or being defeated in a competition, game, or contest.

examples.japanese: {負|ま}け⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{認|みと}める→認める：02429_mitomeru⟧。
⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{試合|しあい}→試合：01601_shiai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{負|ま}け⟦だった→だ：09496_da⟧。
3⟦{連敗|れんぱい}→連敗：06529_renpai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{負|ま}け⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}いている→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧。
examples.english: Losses continue with three consecutive defeats.

examples.japanese: ⟦{昨日|きのう}→昨日：00859_kinou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{試合|しあい}→試合：01601_shiai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{悔|くや}しい→悔しい：02343_kuyashii⟧{負|ま}け⟦だった→だ：09496_da⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{次|つぎ}→次：00819_tsugi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{必|かなら}ず→必ず：01249_kanarazu⟧⟦{勝|か}つ→勝つ：01199_katsu⟧。
examples.english: Yesterday's match was a frustrating loss, but we'll definitely win next time.

examples.japanese: {負|ま}け⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}く→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{気持|きも}ち→気持ち：01385_kimochi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{落|お}ち{込|こ}む→落ち込む：05750_ochikomu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{諦|あきら}めず→諦める：01813_akirameru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{練習|れんしゅう}→練習：05323_renshuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{続|つづ}ける→続ける：01231_tsuzukeru⟧⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: When losses pile up you feel down, but it's important to keep practicing without giving up.

notes:
{負|ま}け is the noun form of ⟦{負|ま}ける→負ける：01134_makeru⟧ (to lose). It indicates defeat in competition.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {負|ま}け⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{込|こ}む→込む：00719_komu⟧ (to be on a losing streak)
- {負|ま}け⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{認|みと}める→認める：02429_mitomeru⟧ (to acknowledge defeat)
- {負|ま}け⟦{知|し}らず→知らず：noentry⟧ (undefeated)

SPORTS/COMPETITION:
- ⟦{勝|か}ち{負|ま}け→勝ち負け：11928_kachimake⟧ (winning and losing, victory and defeat)
- 3⟦{勝|しょう}→勝：noentry⟧2⟦{敗|はい}→敗：noentry⟧ (3 wins, 2 losses)
- {負|ま}け⟦{越|こ}し→越し：noentry⟧ (more losses than wins)

IDIOMATIC:
- ⟦{負|ま}け{惜|お}しみ→負け惜しみ：07308_makeoshimi⟧ (sour grapes, being a sore loser)
- ⟦{負|ま}け{犬|いぬ}→負け犬：14255_makeinu⟧ (underdog, loser)
